text:
Aisha Rahman: Quick coordination thread for marketplace launch window + packaging. Scope: AWS/GCP/Azure initial listing, legal/EULA, hero assets, AMI/GCP/managed image, SKU/pricing matrix, trial entitlements, and joint announcement timing with SI partner VoltOps. Need owners and dates.

Tom Becker: I can own image builds (AWS AMI x86 & arm64, GCP PV and custom image). Need publisher IDs and any marketplace smoke-test requirements. Also need to know if VoltOps wants a co-branded hero.

Nora Li: Marketing will provide a co-branded hero but legal must sign the release. Ill get three sizes: banner, tile, thumbnail. Target assets by Wed.

Ethan Vogel: Legal: EULA final draft ready but need incident contact and support SLA bullets for the listing. Also confirm phrasing for SI: "listed with VoltOps integration" vs "joint offering". We prefer "listed with".

Aisha Rahman: VoltOps prefers a coordinated announcement the same day the listing goes live. Proposed launch window: 2026-04-15 to allow QA. We should set a submission date of 2026-04-08. Owners?

Tom Becker: Image ETA: AMIs built and testable by 2026-04-01, GCP images by 2026-04-02. Will include cloud-init that writes /etc/marketplace-validate and a small health endpoint.

Nora Li: Co-branded hero will be ready 2026-04-03. Will attach logo release form; legal needs to sign. Will also prepare marketplace screenshots (login, admin, billing).

Ethan Vogel: EULA + logo release: Ill upload EULA PDF and a signed logo release when marketing and VoltOps legal approve. SLA bullets: response time 24h for Sev 1, 72h for Sev 2, plus escalation matrix.

MarketplaceBot: Ticket MP-5401 created: "marketplace intake + VoltOps co-sell" assigned partnerships. https://tickets.redwood.example/MP-5401

Aisha Rahman: SKUs: RedwoodInference.API (hosted), RedwoodInference.Dedicated, RedwoodInference.Appliance-VoltOps. Pricing rows: hourly list + monthly commit. Trial: 30 days, 50k token cap. Product confirm quotas?

Tom Becker: Will bake validation token into images: example file /etc/marketplace-validate containing `voltops-rsw-0426`. Also will publish AMI name convention: redwood-inference-ami-ubuntu22-<region>-<arch>-2026-04-01.

Nora Li: Adding messaging for announcement: short partner quote from VoltOps, 2 screenshots, and a step-by-step deploy guide. Will draft and share.

Ethan Vogel: KMS/keys wording for portal: "Customer-managed keys supported for Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted uses Redwood-managed keys by default." Also telemetry line: "We collect anonymized, non-PII metrics for reliability; customers can opt-out on Dedicated/Private."

Aisha Rahman: Action list: Tom = images + validation artifacts (due 2026-04-02), Nora = hero assets + announcement draft (2026-04-03), Ethan = finalize EULA + SI language + upload legal artifacts (2026-04-04), Aisha = coordinate submission and set portal intake 2026-04-08. Target launch 2026-04-15.

Tom Becker: +1, will post AMI and image IDs here when available.

Nora Li: +, will ping VoltOps for quote.

Ethan Vogel: +, uploading docs to MP-5401 once signed.

Aisha Rahman: Scheduling a 20 min sync Tue 9am PT to confirm readiness. Reply + if attending.
